description:
The top and trending NFT collections on GONDI right now, ranked as
GONDI's collections table ranks them: each with its floor price in its
currency and in USD, the floor's change, the volume traded and the
number of sales over the period, and gondi_url, its page. Answers "what
are the top NFT collections", "what's trending" and "which collections
sold the most this week". A collection and its wrappers (CryptoPunks and
its wrapped forms) are one row, under the collection they wrap; user
vaults, hidden collections and shared contracts that mint many artists'
works (SuperRare, Foundation) are left out.

chain.description: Only this chain; every chain if unset.

period.description: The window volume, sales and floor change cover.
period.title: Period

sort_by.description: VOLUME and SALES rank by the period's traded volume and sale count. TRENDING, GONDI's Trending, ranks by how far the last day's volume runs above the week's daily average, whatever the period. MARKET_CAP, GONDI's Top, ranks by floor times supply. FLOOR_CHANGE ranks by the period's floor change. Highest first.
sort_by.title: Sort By

name: list_top_collections

amount_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

floor_change_percent.description: How far the floor moved over the period, in ETH terms; null without a floor now or at the period's start.
floor_change_percent.title: Floor Change Percent

floor_price.description: The lowest price an NFT of the collection is listed for; null when none is.

sales.description: How many of its NFTs sold over the period.
sales.title: Sales

volume.description: What its NFTs sold for over the period, in the chain's native currency.
